climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: The coolest-climate grape-growing region in New South Wales, in the Southern New South Wales zone on the western foothills of the Snowy Mountains at 980 to 2,600 feet. It is known for sparkling wines and cool-climate table wines, with Chardonnay and Pinot Noir leading.
